newsitem.title: USA: Minn Twins owner may up stadium contribution - paper.
newsitem.headline: Minn Twins owner may up stadium contribution - paper.

text.p: Minnesota Twins owner Carl Pohlad may offer to contribute up to $100 million for a new stadium for the American League baseball club, the Star Tribune reported.

Pohlad has talked about contributing $15 million up front and another $35 million in a loan toward building a new stadium, but could increase that amount in a bid to gain approval of a new stadium bill before the Minnesota Legislature adjourns on May 19, the Star Tribune reported.
How much of the additional money would come from the ballclub and how much from other revenues is not clear, the newspaper said.
A hearing has been scheduled next week for a proposal to finance a new stadium through new casino revenues, the newspaper said.
